data.title: 阿尼斯 · 休息室沙发透视黑蕾丝的慵懒纠缠
data.description: 深夜的指挥官私人休息室，阿尼斯深陷在柔软的皮质大沙发上。黑色半透明蕾丝连体衣紧贴丰腴曼妙的身体曲线，她一手扶着沙发靠背，另一手轻撩耳畔碎发，眼神里带着微醺般的浓郁爱意与邀请。
data.location: 指挥官私人套房休息沙发
data.action: 倚坐沙发扶手，轻抚锁骨露出慵懒撩人神情
data.lighting: 昏暗房间角落的一盏落地复古台灯暖光
data.promptProse: Leaning back into the deep leather couch of the private quarters, her sheer black lace bodysuit traces every curve. The lone amber floor lamp casts long, sultry shadows across her flushed skin as she parts her lips in quiet invitation.
data.animaCaption: She leans back on the leather couch in black lace, looking at the viewer with a sultry blush.
